text: You ask a chatbot to update an agreement.
It writes back: here's your revised agreement.
Then you open the file... and the formatting's wrecked.
So you fix it by hand. Then, an email.
Please add the updated financial annexure and the presentation, before the meeting.
Five tabs. Copy. Paste. Check. Repeat.
What if AI could finish the work?
Meet Agentic Office. Your Word, Excel and PowerPoint files in one workspace, with an assistant that does the fixing.
Bring in your team. It's one agentic, collaborative workspace: people and their assistants, on the same files. Only a person says yes.
Agentic Office. Agents that work with your work... not against it.
